note: Roles reflect Stage 1 grouping design, not a scientifically validated ML train/test split. Dataflare's single 'train' split is NOT treated as a valid split here.
rationale: Grouped by first-present field of ['citation_key', 'law_id', 'document_id', 'source_id', 'case_id', 'question_group'] to avoid splitting records that share law/document/case identity across train/val/test; 2005 groups assigned via seeded hash bucketing (seed=42). Records in metadata-variant duplicate clusters are additionally quarantined regardless of their hash-based role, pending manual review.
